info.title: openhomeradio
info.description: Command-line tool for OpenHomeRadio: send, receive, capture and decode 868 MHz home-automation radio protocols (the Domino and IoHome protocol families) with an ADALM-PLUTO software-defined radio.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Send, receive, capture and decode 868 MHz home-automation radio protocols with an ADALM-PLUTO SDR.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: selftest
commands.description: Check the protocol implementations without hardware: the published IoHome test vectors, and modulate/demodulate round trips of both protocols.

commands.name: receive
commands.description: Print every decoded frame of all protocols from one shared receive stream.

options.name: --host
options.description: Network address of the ADALM-PLUTO. [default: 192.168.2.1]

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port of the radio's IIO daemon. [default: 30431]

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Record raw I/Q at the shared receive tuning, flagging and decoding buffers that contain a signal. Example: openhomeradio capture 10 remote.cs16

options.name: --host
options.description: Network address of the ADALM-PLUTO. [default: 192.168.2.1]

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port of the radio's IIO daemon. [default: 30431]

arguments.name: FILE.CS16
arguments.description: Output file (raw interleaved little-endian int16 I/Q).

commands.name: decode
commands.description: Decode all protocols from a capture file.

options.name: --center
options.description: The tuning the file was recorded at, in Hz. [default: 868750000]

options.name: --rate
options.description: The file's sample rate, in Hz. [default: 2500000]

arguments.name: FILE.CS16
arguments.description: Capture file: raw interleaved little-endian int16 I/Q, as written by 'capture'.

commands.name: domino
commands.description: Domino protocol (869.0 MHz): blinds, lights and switches.

commands.name: send
commands.description: Send a command as a remote button. Example: openhomeradio domino send 123456 20 ContinuousDown

options.name: --value
options.description: The command's argument, decimal (for example a lock level).

options.name: --counter
options.description: Counter byte to send, hex. An actuator ignores a counter equal to the last one it saw. Default random.

options.name: --attenuation
options.description: Transmit power back-off in dB (0 = maximum power). [default: 10]

options.name: --host
options.description: Network address of the ADALM-PLUTO. [default: 192.168.2.1]

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port of the radio's IIO daemon. [default: 30431]

arguments.name: GROUP
arguments.description: Group byte of the remote, hex (e.g. 20).

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: One of Up, Down, ContinuousUp, ContinuousDown, Stop, Toggle, Save, LockLevelSet, LockLevelClear, RestorePosition, LongPress.

commands.name: receive
commands.description: Print received Domino button presses, one line per press.

options.name: --host
options.description: Network address of the ADALM-PLUTO. [default: 192.168.2.1]

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port of the radio's IIO daemon. [default: 30431]

commands.name: decode
commands.description: Decode Domino frames from a capture file.

options.name: --center
options.description: The tuning the file was recorded at, in Hz. [default: 868750000]

options.name: --rate
options.description: The file's sample rate, in Hz. [default: 2500000]

arguments.name: FILE.CS16
arguments.description: Capture file: raw interleaved little-endian int16 I/Q, as written by 'capture'.

commands.name: iohome
commands.description: IoHome protocol (868.95 MHz, single-way): windows and blinds.

commands.name: send
commands.description: Move the actuators paired with a remote. Example: openhomeradio iohome send 000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F ABCDEF down --sequence 1

options.name: --sequence
options.description: Sequence number (rolling code) to send, hex. Must be above the last one the actuator accepted from this address. Default 0.

options.name: --offsets
options.description: Transmit frequency corrections in Hz: min:max:step for a sweep, or one value for no sweep. Default -20000:20000:2500.

options.name: --attenuation
options.description: Transmit power back-off in dB (0 = maximum power). [default: 0]

options.name: --destination
options.description: Destination node, hex. Default: broadcast to every actuator paired with this remote.

options.name: --host
options.description: Network address of the ADALM-PLUTO. [default: 192.168.2.1]

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port of the radio's IIO daemon. [default: 30431]

arguments.name: ADDRESS
arguments.description: 24-bit address of the remote to transmit as, hex (e.g. ABCDEF).

arguments.name: ACTION
arguments.description: up, down, stop, or a position 0..100 % (positions follow the protocol documentation; not verified on hardware).

commands.name: pair
commands.description: Pair a remote with every actuator in learn mode (1W key transfer). Put the actuator into learn mode first. Example: openhomeradio iohome pair 000102030405060708090A0B0C0D0E0F ABCDEF

options.name: --sequence
options.description: Sequence number (rolling code) to send, hex. Must be above the last one the actuator accepted from this address. Default 0.

options.name: --offsets
options.description: Transmit frequency corrections in Hz: min:max:step for a sweep, or one value for no sweep. Default -20000:20000:2500.

options.name: --attenuation
options.description: Transmit power back-off in dB (0 = maximum power). [default: 0]

options.name: --host
options.description: Network address of the ADALM-PLUTO. [default: 192.168.2.1]

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port of the radio's IIO daemon. [default: 30431]

arguments.name: ADDRESS
arguments.description: 24-bit address of the remote to transmit as, hex (e.g. ABCDEF).

commands.name: diagnose
commands.description: Report bursts, tones, frequency offsets and sync words in a capture file, to tell 'no signal' from 'signal but not decodable'.

options.name: --center
options.description: The tuning the file was recorded at, in Hz. [default: 868750000]

options.name: --rate
options.description: The file's sample rate, in Hz. [default: 2500000]

arguments.name: FILE.CS16
arguments.description: Capture file: raw interleaved little-endian int16 I/Q, as written by 'capture'.

commands.name: genkey
commands.description: Print a new random 16-byte system key for a new remote.

commands.name: recoverkey
commands.description: Print the system key contained in a captured 1W key transfer. Only use this on installations you own or are authorised to control.

arguments.name: KEYTRANSFERFRAMEHEX
arguments.description: A captured 1W key transfer (command 30), hex, as printed by 'receive'.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Check a system key against a captured frame's MAC, without transmitting anything.

arguments.name: FRAMEHEX
arguments.description: A captured frame, hex, as printed by 'receive'.
